selected_proposal.improvement_reason: Uniform 90 (8 ticks, effective schedule 90,90,90,90) is a bold jump that reaches the top of the declared working interval and covers the largest untested region above the incumbent in one formal population rather than several near-duplicate micro-steps. No confirmed level produced excluded upper-tail samples, so the high-strength region is not yet shown to be harmful, and the only prior look at 90 came from an unrankable 10-sample reading.
selected_proposal.uncertainty: There is no rankable evidence at 90 at all, and both the displacement and native-increment ratio grow with strength in window 0, so this jump could inflate the upper tail or leave several molecules unbuilt/unconnected as happened at 50 (49 of 50 built) and 70 (49 of 50 built). It may also land in the same flat band as 40-70.

selected_proposal.improvement_reason: All four completed full populations are uniform, so a per-window split is an untested region: effective schedule 70,70,60,60 (6 ticks, audited as an optimization task using only confirmed levels) keeps the windows that actually move atoms at the incumbent-best level while relaxing the two late windows. Uniform 60 (0.6537) was worse than uniform 70 (0.6380) and uniform 50 (0.6477), so redistributing rather than uniformly lowering is a plausible better combination, and it costs no range-evidence budget.
selected_proposal.uncertainty: No mixed schedule has been measured, so the effect of a per-window split is unknown; the late windows show very small increments (window 3 about 0.0026 A RMS at 70) which might mean the split is nearly identical to uniform 70, or that the late windows still matter for final coverage. This can easily land inside the existing 0.638-0.654 band.

selected_proposal.improvement_reason: 当前最优是统一 90 的完整人口 0.5901；该配置在窗口 3 的增量为全部窗口最小（RMS 约 0.0026 A，native ratio 约 0.087，coefficient_last 约 -0.010），因此只把该窗口下调一档到已确认的 70，是最小的未测改动，同时保留承担主要形变的早期窗口强度。已测的唯一混合档 70,70,60,60（0.6385）与统一 70 落在同一噪声带，说明窗口拆分尚未被证明有害。
selected_proposal.uncertainty: 改动可能近乎无效，最终落在与统一 90 同一条带而消耗一次完整人口；反过来，极小的晚期增量仍可能对终态覆盖有作用，下调后可能略差。

assignment_diagnostics_not_used_for_rank.aggregation: raw arithmetic mean over the complete population

selected_proposal.improvement_reason: 窗口 0 主导整条轨迹：在 90 时它拥有最大的增量 RMS、最大的单原子增量与最高的匹配切换，而窗口 1-3 的原子位移小得多。只在窗口 0 保留 90、把后三个窗口降回已确认的 70（6 刻度），是尚未测过的组合，把强度集中在实测真正发生位移的位置，并检查早期窗口是否承担了 0.5901 的收益。
selected_proposal.uncertainty: 若窗口 1-3 仍实质贡献，该配置会回落到 50-70 统一档所在的 0.638-0.654 带；还没有任何带 90 分量的混合档实测，拆分效应完全未知。

assignment_diagnostics_not_used_for_rank.aggregation: raw arithmetic mean over the complete population

selected_proposal.improvement_reason: 跨邻域跳跃：两个高活动窗口保持在 90，两个晚期窗口直接降到已确认的中间档 50（8 刻度，强度 80）。90 时晚期窗口的系数与增量已接近零，这一组合检查当前最优的收益是否几乎全部来自窗口 0-1，而晚期窗口只是对预测终态加入小幅扰动，从而给出一种与现有统一档完全不同的强度分布。
selected_proposal.uncertainty: 两端都是未测组合；把晚期引导降到 50 可能使终态覆盖略差，且 50 落在宽松工作区间 70-110 之外（尽管属于已确认档位），结果也可能与统一 90 无法区分。
